jurisdiction.name: Ecuador
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Ecuador governs AI through the telecommunications ministry's (MINTEL) Strategy for the Ethical and Responsible Development and Use of AI 2025-2029, in force since its publication in the Official Register in January 2026, and through a 2023 ministerial order creating an AI committee. The data protection authority (SPDP) issued a binding 2026 rule applying the 2021 data protection law to AI systems, and a policy on AI use in its own administrative processes. The 2021 law itself regulates automated decisions. In 2026 the production ministry adopted ISO/IEC 22989 and ISO/IEC 42001 as voluntary national standards. An AI regulatory sandbox has been announced and an AI bill is pending in the National Assembly.
lead_institutions: Ministerio de Telecomunicaciones y de la Sociedad de la Información (MINTEL)
Superintendencia de Protección de Datos Personales (SPDP)
narrative.review_notes: This review was carried out on 12 October 2026 from documents read in full on official sites. The Official Register's search and the government consultation portal could not be used, so the 2025 consultation draft of the strategy is recorded without its text being read. The pending AI bill and the announced AI sandbox are tracked as leads.

instruments.official_title: Estrategia para el Fomento del Desarrollo y Uso Ético y Responsable de la Inteligencia Artificial en el Ecuador
instruments.english_title: Strategy for Promoting the Development and Ethical and Responsible Use of Artificial Intelligence in Ecuador
instruments.issuing_authority: Ministry of Telecommunications and Information Society (MINTEL), by Ministerial Agreement MINTEL-MINTEL-2025-0030
instruments.publisher_name: Ministry of Telecommunications and Information Society
instruments.current_status: Issued by Acuerdo MINTEL-MINTEL-2025-0030, signed 22 December 2025 and published in the Registro Oficial, Primer Suplemento No. 206, 19 January 2026, when the agreement entered into force. Presented officially by the minister on 10 March 2026. The Viceministry of ICT and the Undersecretariat for the Information Society and Digital Economy are charged with monitoring and periodic updating. MINTEL also publishes the signed agreement and annexes separately on its site (uploads 2026/01).
instruments.summary: Ecuador's first national AI strategy (EFIA), issued by Ministerial Agreement MINTEL-MINTEL-2025-0030 with a four-year horizon (2025-2029) and coordinated by MINTEL as governing body for digital transformation. It sets eleven guiding principles (including human oversight, transparency, information security and a risk-based approach) and three axes: AI governance (ethics, social and labour impact, risk management including an inventory of AI systems in operation), capacity and technology (talent, cloud infrastructure, data), and AI adoption and development (R&D, startups, technology free zones, a regulatory sandbox for emerging technologies, public-sector AI). Each line of action has initiatives with indicators and targets assigned to public bodies.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Current national AI strategy and the anchor of Ecuador's AI governance model; basis for the MINTEL AI regulatory sandbox.
instruments.evidence_reference: curl (browser user agent, --max-time 60): MINTEL-hosted copy of Registro Oficial Primer Suplemento No. 206 (19 January 2026) read in full (pdftotext; 63 pages): Acuerdo MINTEL-MINTEL-2025-0030 signed 22 December 2025, in force on publication in the Registro Oficial, with the strategy annex. Same issue also read on the Constitutional Court's gazette repository (esacc.corteconstitucional.gob.ec). Launch confirmed on MINTEL press release No. 084 of 10 March 2026.

instruments.issuing_authority: Ministry of Telecommunications and Information Society (MINTEL)

instruments.summary: Ministerial agreement ordering the actions needed to create the Artificial Intelligence Committee as a consultation, coordination and articulation mechanism to promote the implementation, monitoring and evaluation of AI development strategies in Ecuador. The committee may include public bodies, the private sector, civil society, academia and citizens, and acts under the Organic Law for Digital and Audiovisual Transformation; MINTEL's Undersecretariat for the Information Society and Digital Economy is charged with its creation.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Founding instrument of Ecuador's multi-stakeholder AI Committee, whose recommendations produced the national AI strategy.

instruments.official_title: Norma General para la Garantía del Derecho de Protección de Datos Personales en el Uso de Sistemas de Inteligencia Artificial
instruments.english_title: General Rule Guaranteeing the Right to Personal Data Protection in the Use of Artificial Intelligence Systems (Resolution SPDP-SPD-2026-0009-R)
instruments.issuing_authority: Superintendency of Personal Data Protection (SPDP), Resolution SPDP-SPD-2026-0009-R
instruments.current_status: Signed 12 February 2026 and published in Registro Oficial No. 240 of 10 March 2026, on which it entered into force. Amended by Resolution SPDP-SPD-2026-0037-R, signed 9 September 2026 and published in Registro Oficial No. 373 of 21 September 2026 (per the Registro Oficial listing), on which it took effect; it rewrites arts. 1 and 4 to 8, adds definitions of access, visibility and effective control, and adds general provisions limiting processors' obligations to the operations over which they have such access, visibility or control. Both resolutions are listed on the SPDP resolutions page.
instruments.summary: Binding SPDP rule applying the Organic Law on Personal Data Protection to controllers and processors that develop, train, implement, deploy or provide AI systems processing personal data of Ecuadorian data subjects, wherever the system or provider is located. They must inform data subjects clearly about AI-based and automated processing, carry out risk management and impact assessments before development, apply security measures, enter AI processing and automated decisions with legal or rights effects in the record of processing activities, and audit AI systems according to risk; the right not to be subject to automated decisions is guaranteed. The SPDP may audit AI systems and impose corrective and precautionary measures. An amending resolution signed on 9 September 2026 applies these obligations to processors only where they have access to, visibility of or effective control over the data, and only for those operations.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Ecuador's main binding AI-specific rule; defines developer, deployer, distributor and implementer roles for data-protection obligations.
instruments.evidence_reference: curl (browser user agent, --max-time 60): signed resolution PDF embedded on the SPDP page spdp.gob.ec/resol_ia_02_2026/ read in full (pdftotext); signed 12 February 2026; in force on publication in the Registro Oficial. instruments.official_title: Política para el Desarrollo y Uso de la Inteligencia Artificial en Procesos Administrativos de la Superintendencia de Protección de Datos Personales
instruments.english_title: Policy for the Development and Use of Artificial Intelligence in the Administrative Processes of the Superintendency of Personal Data Protection (Resolution SPDP-SPD-2026-0007-R)
instruments.issuing_authority: Superintendency of Personal Data Protection (SPDP), Resolution SPDP-SPD-2026-0007-R
instruments.current_status: Approved by Resolution SPDP-SPD-2026-0007-R, signed 9 February 2026 and in force on signature; binding within the SPDP only. The annexed policy is dated 30 December 2025.
instruments.summary: Mandatory internal policy for all SPDP authorities, staff and units on developing and using AI in the regulator's administrative processes. It sets governance roles for in-house agentic AI and expert systems (organisational lead, agentic-AI lead, development and security leads, with audit rights for the information security officer and data protection officer), lists the activities for which agentic and generative AI may be used, and requires risk management for both covering data protection, fairness, accuracy and robustness, explainability and information security.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: First published public-sector AI-use policy of an Ecuadorian state body; covers generative AI use by officials.
instruments.evidence_reference: curl (browser user agent, --max-time 60): signed resolution and annex PDFs embedded on spdp.gob.ec/resolucionia/ read in full (pdftotext); signed 9 February 2026, in force on signature.

instruments.official_title: Ley Orgánica de Protección de Datos Personales
instruments.english_title: Organic Law on Personal Data Protection
instruments.current_status: Published in the Registro Oficial, Quinto Suplemento No. 459, 26 May 2021, in force on publication. Amended since (consolidated text lists the last reform on 22 May 2026); implemented by the General Regulation and SPDP secondary rules.
instruments.summary: Ecuador's comprehensive data protection law, applying to public and private processing of personal data and creating the Superintendency of Personal Data Protection as supervisory authority. Article 20 gives data subjects the right not to be subject to decisions based solely or partly on automated assessments, including profiling, that produce legal effects or affect their fundamental rights, with rights to a reasoned explanation, to submit observations, to obtain the evaluation criteria and data sources, and to challenge the decision.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Legal basis for regulating AI that processes personal data, including the SPDP's 2026 AI rule.
instruments.evidence_reference: curl (browser user agent, --max-time 60): MINTEL-hosted scan of Registro Oficial Quinto Suplemento No. 459 (26 May 2021) confirmed title, issue and date (image PDF, 70 pages, no text layer); article text (art. 20 and final provision) read from the consolidated text also hosted on telecomunicaciones.gob.ec (2026/06, LEXIS-sourced consolidation, last reform 22 May 2026).

instruments.summary: National adoption, identical to ISO/IEC 22989:2022, of the international standard setting AI terminology and describing core AI concepts, approved by the Ministry of Production's Undersecretariat of Quality on the proposal of the Ecuadorian Standardisation Service (INEN). The resolution says it can be used in developing other standards and to support communication between stakeholders, and applies to all types of organisations, including government agencies. It is voluntary.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: National adoption of ISO/IEC 22989 (AI concepts and terminology), the reference vocabulary for other AI standards.

organizations.name: Ministry of Telecommunications and Information Society
organizations.ai_governance_role: Ministerio de Telecomunicaciones y de la Sociedad de la Información (MINTEL): governing body for telecommunications, the information society and digital transformation. Issued the national AI strategy (Acuerdo MINTEL-MINTEL-2025-0030) and the 2023 order creating the AI Committee, coordinates AI governance under the strategy and is leading the design of an AI regulatory sandbox.

organizations.name: Superintendency of Personal Data Protection
organizations.ai_governance_role: Superintendencia de Protección de Datos Personales (SPDP): data protection supervisory authority created by the Organic Law on Personal Data Protection. Issued the general rule on data protection in the use of AI systems (SPDP-SPD-2026-0009-R), may audit AI systems processing personal data, and adopted an internal AI-use policy.

organizations.name: National Assembly
organizations.ai_governance_role: Asamblea Nacional: unicameral legislature; enacted the Organic Law on Personal Data Protection (2021). AI bills: the Proyecto de Ley Orgánica de Regulación y Promoción de Inteligencia Artificial was archived by the Plenary on 15 September 2026; a new AI governance bill was filed on 1 September 2026.

organizations.name: Ministry of Production, Foreign Trade and Investment
organizations.ai_governance_role: Ministerio de Producción, Comercio Exterior e Inversiones (MPCEI): through its Undersecretariat of Quality, approves and makes official the Ecuadorian technical standards prepared by the Ecuadorian Standardisation Service (INEN), including the national adoptions of ISO/IEC 22989 and ISO/IEC 42001 on AI (2026).

coverage_audit.technical_note:
Coverage note (original): Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-12, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. Registro Oficial site search unusable; Diálogo 2.0 consultation portal HTTP 502 (draft strategy i-77f277979193 stays primary_source_located, dated 2025-08-01 from consultation dates stated in the adopted strategy). Strategy source: RO 1S No. 206 copy hosted on MINTEL. Acuerdo MINTEL-2023-0019: signed copy 16 Nov 2023 vs strategy 30 Nov 2023 (signed date used). SPDP-SPD-2026-0009-R effective_date null (RO 240 of 10 Mar 2026 secondary only). LOPDP art. 20 read from LEXIS consolidated copy on telecomunicaciones.gob.ec (gazette scan has no text layer). SPDP internal AI policy kept: it is a binding policy on AI use in the authority's administrative processes. Health, labour, defence, SRI, interior, INEN sites not searched directly. Convention 108: not a party. Units covered: Law: Registro Oficial site search (no usable results) and gazette copies on MINTEL and Constitutional Court sites; National Assembly news on AI bills. Found: Organic Law on Personal Data Protection (art. 20 automated decisions). Organic Law for Digital and Audiovisual Transformation searched: no AI provisions. No AI law; one AI bill archived 15 Sep 2026, one pending (leads). No deepfake offence enacted (only proposed in the pending bill).; Government: MINTEL site and media library: national AI strategy (2026), its consultation draft (2025), AI Committee order (2023); Digital Transformation Policy 2025-2030 (lead, AI in passing); AI sandbox announced, no instrument yet.; Ministries: Education, justice/judiciary (Consejo de la Judicatura), and other ministries searched via web search: searched, nothing found. Labour, health, defence, finance/tax (SRI), interior: not searched individually beyond general queries; nothing surfaced.; Regulators: SPDP: AI general rule (SPDP-SPD-2026-0009-R), internal AI policy (SPDP-SPD-2026-0007-R), draft reform and 2025 draft (leads). Superintendencia de Bancos, SERCOP, ARCOTEL: searched, nothing AI-specific found. Superintendency of Economic Competition: ethics-code AI reform reported (lead). No national cyber or standards-body AI document found (INEN not searched directly).. Not reached: Registro Oficial full-text search (site search returned no results; edition No. 240 of 10 March 2026 not located officially); Diálogo 2.0 consultation portal (HTTP 502); Individual ministry sites (health, labour, defence, SRI, interior) and INEN/standards body not searched directly; Asamblea Nacional bill-tracking system (bill texts not read). leads.title: Proyecto de Ley Orgánica para el Desarrollo, Uso Ético y Gobernanza de la Inteligencia Artificial
leads.english_title: Bill for an Organic Law on the Development, Ethical Use and Governance of Artificial Intelligence
leads.issuing_authority: National Assembly (filed by Assembly member Cecilia Baltazar)
leads.note: Pending bill, filed 1 September 2026 (Asamblea Nacional press note, asambleanacional.gob.ec/es/node/118939): risk classification, rights, governance, innovation and liability regime, with reforms to the Código Orgánico Integral Penal on AI misuse. Bill text not read; record if enacted. Update (Asamblea Nacional news, 30 September 2026, asambleanacional.gob.ec/es/noticia/119810): the Council of Legislative Administration (CAL) qualified the bill and sent it to the Comisión de Educación, Cultura, Ciencia, Tecnología, Innovación y Saberes Ancestrales, which may combine it with related bills. Still a draft; bill text not linked. 2026-11-17: Assembly page of 4 November 2026 (asambleanacional.gob.ec/es/node/120591): Education Commission received input on the bill; still in committee, no law in the Registro Oficial. 2026-11-24: Assembly news of 11 November 2026 (asambleanacional.gob.ec/es/noticia/120764) reports the Education Committee receiving proposals on the bill from the National Police, the Attorney General's Office, the Ombudsman and others (criminal investigation of AI misuse, biometric surveillance, human review of automated decisions); still in committee.

leads.title: Proyecto de Ley Orgánica de Regulación y Promoción de Inteligencia Artificial en Ecuador
leads.english_title: Bill for an Organic Law on the Regulation and Promotion of Artificial Intelligence in Ecuador
leads.note: Archived by the Plenary at first debate on 15 September 2026 (88 votes) on the report of the Education, Culture, Science and Technology Committee (asambleanacional.gob.ec/es/noticia/119354). Other 2024 AI bills were reported by the press; their status was not checked. Not a record.

leads.title: Proyecto de Reglamento de Inteligencia Artificial (SPDP, 2025)
leads.note: Draft file pr_REGLAMENTO-INTELIGENCIA-ARTIFICIAL_0825_postdaj.pdf on spdp.gob.ec (uploads 2025/09), apparently the predecessor of Resolution SPDP-SPD-2026-0009-R. Official document on spdp.gob.ec; no stated publication date found; not read.

leads.title: Sandbox Regulatorio de Inteligencia Artificial (MINTEL)
leads.issuing_authority: Ministry of Telecommunications and Information Society
leads.note: Presented 24 March 2026 (MINTEL press release No. 089) under line of action 18 of the national AI strategy; an implementation plan is being prepared with UNDP. No official sandbox instrument found as of 12 October 2026; record once issued. 2026-11-17: Registro Oficial search for 'inteligencia artificial' (latest hit 20 July 2026) shows no sandbox instrument.

leads.title: Política Pública para la Transformación Digital del Ecuador 2025-2030
leads.english_title: Public Policy for the Digital Transformation of Ecuador 2025-2030
leads.issuing_authority: Ministry of Telecommunications and Information Society
leads.note: General digital policy; AI appears only in one principle (freedom of choice in interactions with algorithms and AI systems) and as an example under the emerging-technologies axis. Below the scope test; cited as a basis of the AI strategy. https://www.telecomunicaciones.gob.ec/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/Politica-Publica-para-la-Transformacion-Digital-Ecuador-2025-2030-MINTEL-signed_f.pdf Issuing act details: Ministry of Telecommunications and Information Society (Acuerdo MINTEL-MINTEL-2025-0005, signed 14 March 2025; Registro Oficial Primer Suplemento No. 15, 8 April 2025 per the AI strategy).

leads.title: Código de ética de la Superintendencia de Competencia Económica (reforma sobre uso de IA)
leads.english_title: Superintendency of Economic Competition code of ethics (AI-use reform)
leads.note: Press reports say the SCE amended its institutional ethics code to add principles on staff use of AI. Official text not located; internal instrument. 2026-11-17: the Registro Oficial search lists the SCE's own AI instruments: SCE-DS-2025-13 'Guía de Uso de Herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial' (RO 8 April 2025), SCE-DS-2025-34 'Código de Ética de Inteligencia Artificial' (RO 16 June 2025), SCE-DS-2025-65 'Guía para la Auditoría del Uso de Herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial' (RO 31 October 2025) and SCE-DS-2026-5 internal regulation on AI governance (RO No. 234, 2 March 2026). Titles indicate internal use within the SCE (scope test); texts not opened. Stays a lead.

leads.title: Resolución N° SPDP-SPD-2026-0038-R (reforma al Reglamento para la presentación, recepción y trámite de denuncias y solicitudes) and Resolución N° SPDP-SPD-2026-0040-R (Norma Técnica de Notificaciones de Vulneraciones de la Seguridad de los Datos Personales)
leads.english_title: SPDP resolutions amending the complaints rule and issuing the personal-data breach notification technical rule
leads.note: Both signed 9 September 2026 and posted on spdp.gob.ec/resoluciones/; they take effect on publication in the Registro Oficial (not confirmed). They regulate the SPDP's own use of AI tools (AI-assisted triage of complaints with human review; the AIxSPDP agentic system for breach notifications) within general data-protection procedures, so AI is not their subject: held as leads under the scope test. Also SPDP-SPD-2026-0039-R (general rule on biometric data processing, signed 9 September 2026): not AI-specific.

leads.title: Guía de Gestión de Riesgos y Evaluación de Impacto del Tratamiento de Datos Personales (Resolución SPDP-SPD-2025-0003-R)
leads.english_title: SPDP guide on risk management and data protection impact assessment
leads.note: Registro Oficial No. 41, Fourth Supplement, 19 May 2025 (official copy on the Constitutional Court's Registro Oficial repository, esacc.corteconstitucional.gob.ec/storage/api/v1/10_DWL_FL/eyJjYXJwZXRhIjoicm8iLCJ1dWlkIjoiYTg2MzE3MjUtZGZjMy00N2EzLWE1NGQtNTk5NGM1NzA4OTlhLnBkZiJ9). General risk-management and DPIA guide, signed 29 April 2025; chapter I is mandatory. AI is mentioned only in passing (ISO/IEC 42001 reference, attacks on AI systems, predictive analytics), so below the scope test. Reconsider if the DPIA duty is judged relevant for AI systems.

leads.title: Proyectos de ley sobre inteligencia artificial en trámite en la Asamblea Nacional (uso de IA en la Función Judicial, explotación sexual infantil mediante IA en el COIP, simulaciones de imagen y voz, protección de la voz humana, competencias de IA en educación)
leads.english_title: Other pending AI bills in the National Assembly (AI in the judiciary, AI-enabled child sexual exploitation, AI simulations of image and voice, protection of the human voice, AI skills in education)
leads.note: Press (kchcomunicacion.com/?p=559189, 11 October 2026) lists 12 pending AI bills. Qualified by the CAL: reform of the Código Orgánico de la Función Judicial on AI use in the administration of justice (Mónica Salazar, filed 18 June 2026, Justice Committee); COIP reform on AI-linked sexual exploitation of minors (Gema Dueñas, 26 March 2026, Justice Committee); bill on AI-generated simulations of images, voices, audio and video (María Paula Villacreses, 25 March 2026, Education Committee); Ley Orgánica para la protección de la voz humana frente al uso de tecnologías de IA (Paola Cabezas, November 2025, Education Committee). Not yet qualified: AI competencies in the education system (Christopher Jaramillo, December 2025); six AI-training reforms (Gerardo Machado). Check each on the Assembly's bill portal; drafts only, not records. 2026-11-10: Asamblea Nacional news page of 4 November 2026 (asambleanacional.gob.ec/es/node/120591) reports the Education Commission continuing analysis of the AI bill with hearings; still pending, no law.

leads.title: Orientaciones para el uso pedagógico de herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial en el proceso de enseñanza aprendizaje que garanticen el uso efectivo y ético en el aula
leads.english_title: Guidance on the pedagogical use of AI tools in teaching and learning
leads.note: Official Ministry of Education PDF (recursos.educacion.gob.ec/wp-content/uploads/REDA/AED/orientaciones_uso_pedag%C3%B3gico_ia.pdf), read: classroom guidance on the effective and ethical pedagogical use of AI. No printed publication date, so not yet a record; find a dated official page or Acuerdo Ministerial.
